records.revalidation_trigger: Revalidate if the official Programa Oficial category, event-title/permalink pattern, operator identity, or source-visible calendar behaviour changes.
limitations: Only Hipódromo Presidente Remón is covered.
Event-page and calendar operating hours such as 08:00-17:00 must not be interpreted as race times.
Unlisted future dates are outside the source-visible published horizon and are not evidence of non-running.
Detailed programme documents, participant data, betting-oriented material and results remain excluded.
records.notes: Live revalidation on 2026-09-26 confirmed the current official Programa Oficial category and current September event titles, including 2026-09-26 and 2026-09-27. The automatic adapter extracts date plus the single physical racecourse at rank C only.
